'You may play Howl from Beyond from your banished zone. / The next attack action card you play this turn gains +3{p}.' + **Go again** / **Blood Debt**, Shadow Action (ChaneBlitzDeck).

PRINTED KEYWORDS NOT AUTHORED: GoAgain and BloodDebt both appear in printed_keywords and fire from the card DB keywords field engine-side (go again pays +1 AP when this non-attack card layer resolves; blood debt is a start-of-end-phase lose-1-life trigger while face-up in the banished zone). Re-authoring either would be a defect. Both are unconditional printed lines, so no SOURCE_IS_ATTACK conditional-keyword shape applies.

CLAUSE 1 - play-from-banished PERMISSION, not a cost: declarative STATIC PLAYABLE_FROM_BANISHED, shape copied from the verified siblings howl_from_beyond_blue.json and howl_from_beyond_yellow.json (same wording). Engine-READ, never resolved: play._self_playable_from_banished (play.py:786-797) scans the card's declared static effect types while it sits in the banished zone, and the play-offering path consults it.

CLAUSE 2 - pump: MODIFY_NEXT_ATTACK with a filter, shape copied from the verified siblings (same card, different amount). ATTACK_TYPE_IN ['Action'] + ATTACK_SUBTYPE_IN ['Attack'] together name exactly an attack ACTION card. Handler (effect_types.py:4634-4660) reads mod/amount/filter/scope; queues a one-shot entry on the CONTROLLER's dsl_queued_attack_mods, consumed by the first qualifying attack declared that turn; default scope TURN and end-of-turn expiry carry 'this turn'. Amount 3 for the red printing (yellow = 2, blue = 1).

No gaps.
